title: Midday Sunwatch
text:
🌤️ Midday Sunwatch — September 18, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B2.8​)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B3.2 (Peaked September 17, 2026 at 12:16 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 420 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 0.67)
🚨 NOAA Warning: Geomagnetic K-index of 4 expected

The Sun's behaving itself. ☀✨

A broad dark coronal-hole region stands out in today’s solar images, while the visible photosphere remains largely spotless.

Images: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 195, 284, 171, 304, 131, 094 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
